items.source: Uses of AnnotationMatchingPointcut in org.springframework.aop.support.annotation

items.translation: 支持面向切面编程（AOP）切入点注解。

items.source:
Factory method for an AnnotationMatchingPointcut that matches
for the specified annotation at the class level.
items.translation: 用于在类级别匹配指定注解的 AnnotationMatchingPointcut 工厂方法。
